description: Golden vectors for the M2.6 W5 finite workflow contract, third-stage executable action/input/participant closure, and its core-owned basis, binding sync, arbitrary selectable pre-Decision scope target, Draft rebase-anchor commit/recovery, Draft Brief/section revision, export claim/partial reentry, and closed-status P1 repairs. These are contract fixtures, not evidence of a production implementation.
action_input_vector_scope: action_input_vectors validate closed-schema parsing and canonical projection only; vectors validate workflow state, subject, dependency, commit, and recovery behavior.
